details.description: NVIDIA Nemotron Nano 12B v2 VL is a 12.6-billion-parameter vision-language model from NVIDIA, pairing a CRadioV2-H vision encoder with the Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2 language backbone. Released October 28, 2025 under the NVIDIA Nemotron Open Model License, it processes up to 4 images per request at resolutions up to 2048x1536 pixels and can reason over sampled video (8-128 frames), supporting multi-image reasoning, document intelligence, visual question answering and function calling within a 128K-token context window.
advantages: Scored a 74.0% average across NVIDIA's full vision benchmark suite (MMMU, MathVista, AI2D, OCRBench v2, OCRBench, OCR-Reasoning, ChartQA, DocVQA and Video-MME) (Hugging Face model card).
Scored 94.39% on DocVQA and 89.72% on ChartQA (Hugging Face model card).
Scored 87.11% on AI2D and 76.9% on MathVista (Hugging Face model card).
Processes up to 4 images per request at resolutions up to 2048x1536 pixels and can reason over 8-128 sampled video frames (Hugging Face model card).
Supports function calling in addition to vision-language tasks (Hugging Face model card).
disadvantages: English only; no other languages are documented for this model (Hugging Face model card).
use_cases: Multi-image reasoning and visual question answering
Document intelligence for invoices, receipts, manuals and similar documents

sources.title: NVIDIA Nemotron Nano 12B v2 VL BF16 - Amazon Bedrock model card

notes: The Bedrock model id nvidia.nemotron-nano-12b-v2 in this group's URIs maps to NVIDIA's 'Nemotron Nano 12B v2 VL BF16' card, not the base, text-only 'NVIDIA-Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2' card that shares the same short name -- confirmed via AWS's own model card page, whose title is 'NVIDIA Nemotron Nano 12B v2 VL BF16' and which lists image input as supported (matching the catalog's image_input modality and 128K-context/8K-output facts, which the base text-only card would not). Description and evaluations are written for the VL variant accordingly. Corrected the license name to its exact title, 'NVIDIA Nemotron Open Model License'. Corrected the 74.0% 'Vision Average' advantage: the Hugging Face card does not state it is an average of only the 6 benchmarks originally listed -- recomputing the mean of every score shown in the card's evaluation table (MMMU, MathVista, AI2D, OCRBench v2, OCRBench, OCR-Reasoning, ChartQA, DocVQA, Video-MME) gives 74.0, matching the stated 'Vision Average', so the sentence now lists all nine benchmarks instead of a cherry-picked six that don't actually average to 74.0.
